global: pizzicato strings, marimba, toy synth bleeps, light brushed drums

sections.name: hook
sections.style: zippy buzzing synth and fast pizzicato, a gadget zooming around, cheeky and loud, ends on a brass sting

sections.name: keynote
sections.style: grand mock-heroic keynote fanfare, bright brass and timpani, big promise

sections.name: waiting
sections.style: slow deflated tuba and ticking clock woodblock, long wait, then a sudden bright ta-da of arrival

sections.name: carry
sections.style: gentle tiptoe marimba walk, curious bleeps

sections.name: night
sections.style: sleepy music box lullaby, then an alarm-like staccato and a fast whooshing chase

sections.name: charger
sections.style: deadpan comic plunks, patient tick tock, a deflating slide whistle drop and soft thud

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm playful upbeat outro, glockenspiel and bouncy bass, tiny comic button at the end
